purpose: Qualify C08 trajectories against an analytic global swept-tube field plus topology-isolated bounded implicit union windows, after the V1 whole-world dense SDF cost contract failed.

approval.scope: V2 design only; a separately approved one-shot qualification may read only C08 S01/S06/S10 and create zero LiDAR/model/graph/planner outputs.
approval.confirmation_reference: User chose the recommended local-window direction by replying 继续 after the dense-SDF cost failure; this does not approve V2 execution.

raw_sources: The 9 sealed C08 graph/spline/geometry JSON inputs and 3 sealed trajectory NPZ hashes bound in the V1 proposal; V2 must copy and re-verify them before execution.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only Cano-derived research assets; native perception OBJ is excluded from collision-field construction.

strict_test: All C09/C10 and M-TARE worlds are forbidden.

sampling.rule: Global field is analytic and trajectory-free. Only 25 explicit degree>=3 windows (S01=4,S06=7,S10=14), radius 1.10 times maximum incident tunnel radius, use serial 0.10/0.05/0.025m implicit SDF. Only their predeclared route-local frames may jointly change XY/z; all original identities remain.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Hybrid analytic/local-implicit collision field provides geometry evidence only.
teacher.valid_mask: All 4773 frames pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m and up>=0.8m. Window frames have exact three-resolution pass/fail agreement; all seams/manifold and non-incident isolation checks pass.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes outputs; a pass only permits requesting C08 causal replay.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 geometry/trajectory provenance is readable; C09/C10/M-TARE/model outputs are excluded.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D plus serial local implicit SDF windows; peak RAM cap 4 GiB; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: Per-window input membership/radius/overlap, three-resolution convergence, seam/manifold, non-incident isolation, all-frame hybrid clearance and continuity metrics.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Complete world route view plus every junction-window field/patch and all clearance/continuity failures.
evidence.failure_policy: Any seam, overlap, resolution disagreement, failed frame, cap breach, input drift or forbidden read is FAIL; no window/radius/resolution adjustment or retry.
